content: Conditional Random Fields (CRF) BIBREF10 are a standard approach when dealing with sequential data in the context of sequence labeling. We use a combination of linguistic and semantic features, with a context window of size five, to describe each of the tokens and the dependencies between them. Hyper-parameter optimization is performed using randomized search and cross validation. Span-based F1 score is used as the optimization metric.
